recommendation_summary: Set up a single Healthchecks.io completion heartbeat, pinged by the cron wrapper only after `nightly-sync` succeeds, that emails the user if no ping arrives after 03:00 plus the normal runtime and a buffer.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want an alert when `nightly-sync` fails or never runs, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker for this job; neither alone alerts on a missing successful run.
labels.Bottleneck: The script must finish before it can email you, so startup failures stay silent.
labels.Checked myself: Your supplied facts only: daily cron on `edna`, four startup crashes, and no independent alert.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert, rejects the logging and Docker setup, and puts all four specific record lines before the recommendation.
